wireframe_parity_audit.description: Audit all wireframes in wireframes/ against existing codebase. Check mobile/src/screens, frontend/src/pages, backend/internal/handlers.
wireframe_parity_audit.expected_output: WireframeParityReport showing every wireframe with coverage status.

requirements_trace.description: Read REQUIREMENTS_MASTER.md and trace every requirement ID to implementing code in frontend/src, mobile/src, backend/internal.
requirements_trace.expected_output: GapAnalysis showing implemented/missing/partial requirements with traces.

qa_parity_gate.description: Verify every wireframe reachable in mobile navigation (MainTabs, RootStack) and frontend routing (App.tsx). Check learning, marketplace, chat flows.
qa_parity_gate.expected_output: WireframeParityReport with verification results and gate outcome.

release_gate.description: All phase tasks DONE, builds green, tests pass, security scan passes, Go/No-Go complete.
release_gate.expected_output: ReleaseGateCheck with pass/fail for each check and overall verdict.

tdd_rescue_test_quality.description: Replace hollow QA evidence with hard failing-first acceptance tests. Remove legacy Gmail fixtures, console.warn soft-passes, swallowed critical failures, mocked-only acceptance proof, and fs.readFileSync acceptance assertions from C-01/C-04/C-05. Critical tests must drive the real UI/API path and fail when translation, marketplace, teacher apply, or durability is broken.
tdd_rescue_test_quality.expected_output: HardTestEvidenceReport with testRefs, red/green command output, and zero soft-pass patterns in critical tests.

learning_dashboard_rescue.description: Make the mobile-first Learn dashboard actually work: Daily Practice/Quick Drills, Initial Test/Placement, Vocabulary Review, Scenarios, Real Talk, Streak Recovery, monthly metrics, and Learn->Tutors navigation. Each tap must navigate, call the real API, and show loading/success/error states on mobile and web.
learning_dashboard_rescue.expected_output: LearningRescueReport with files changed, APIs exercised, mobile+web tests, and device verification notes.

sparky_chatbot_rescue.description: Make Sparky chatbot/deep-dive interactions work in mobile Chat and scenario roleplay. The FAB/sheet/input/send flow must append the user message, call the learning/grammar API, show Sparky loading, render an assistant response, and render a retryable error state.
sparky_chatbot_rescue.expected_output: SparkyInteractionReport with hard tests proving user input, loading, assistant response, and error path.

device_release_rescue_gate.description: Run the deterministic release gate after the rescue work: python orchestrator.py --audit, verify-wireframe-parity.sh, backend build/vet/test, frontend build/test, mobile typecheck/test, and AVD/device parity when available. Any red check keeps the phase PENDING.
device_release_rescue_gate.expected_output: ReleaseGateCheck with exact commands, exit codes, failed checks, and no DONE if any check fails.
